observations: MainWindow sits at the center of a 54-module strongly connected component that spans 9 of the 10 domains: 116 of the 326 module-to-module edges start or end at ui/main_window.py, 43 modules call back into it, and it reaches 67. Every module in that component depends on MainWindow and MainWindow depends on it, directly or through others, so none of them can move into a web service until those edges are cut.

Back-references carry most of the runtime coupling: 1132 reads and calls from 28 modules go through self.mw, self.main_window or a local mw alias. 17 of the MainWindow members they use are never defined, 14 of them multi-view members such as multi_view_images; those code paths raise or silently do nothing at runtime.

The seven annotation sidecar formats have 9 writer modules and 3 reader modules, and the suffix-to-format mapping is written out four times: the exporter _register calls, FileManager._LOAD_CHAIN, CustomFileSystemModel._FORMAT_COLUMNS and FastFileManager's literals. Adding or renaming a format takes four coordinated edits; the rewrite should own it in one registry.

The exporter package and its seven writers import no Qt, FileManager's only Qt use is a lazily imported QImageReader for the image size (core/file_manager.py:211), and annotation_io is entered from 4 modules outside it (config.settings, ui.main_window, ui.managers.file_navigation_manager, ui.widgets.settings_widget), which makes it the cleanest extraction seam for a file-format library. The SAM wrappers are entered from 7 modules and touch 4 data stores (dl.fbaipublicfiles.com, Image folder (png, jpg, jpeg, tiff, tif), Model checkpoints (*.pth, *.pt), SAM 2 frame staging (JPEG)), the shape of an inference service.

Signal wiring resolves well: of 325 connect() calls, 189 were resolved to in-package modules, 95 wire Qt's own widgets, 36 wire a module's own helper-built widgets to its own slots, and 5 remain unresolved (src/lazylabel/ui/main_window.py:4413, src/lazylabel/ui/managers/ui_layout_manager.py:129, src/lazylabel/utils/fast_file_manager.py:1130, src/lazylabel/utils/fast_file_manager.py:1133). There is no importlib, __import__, entry-point or pkg_resources loading in the package, so the import graph is complete.

Dead-end candidates, with no inbound use from any entry point, import, signal or back-reference: core.app_context, core.protocols, ui.modes.single_view_mode, ui.utils.scene_utils, ui.workers.save_worker. Also unreachable because only those modules use it: ui.modes.base_mode. 5 of the candidates are still re-exported by a package __init__, so they load at import time without ever being used.

Settings is one mutable object on MainWindow, reached through back-references from 6 modules in 3 domains (ai_segmentation, canvas_editing, image_processing), while only config/settings.py writes settings.json. Model checkpoints are written by 2 modules (models.sam_model, ui.workers.reference_finder_worker) into the installed package directory, so a read-only install or container image breaks the SAM 1 download and the Find Archetypes cache.

flows.name: Label an image with AI clicks
flows.description: An annotator opens a folder, clicks objects so SAM draws their masks, and moves on while labels are saved beside each image.

steps.label: Open a folder of images
Pick an image; it appears with any labels saved earlier
The AI model loads once, then prepares each image in the background
Click the object to get a mask preview
Press Space to accept the mask as a labeled object
Go to the next image; labels are saved automatically

flows.name: Carry labels through an image sequence
flows.persona: Researcher labeling a time-lapse or video frame sequence
flows.description: A researcher labels a few reference frames, lets SAM 2 carry the labels through the rest, checks the frames it was unsure about, and saves the results.

steps.label: Choose the first and last frame and build the timeline
Mark frames that already have labels as references
Start propagation with SAM 2
Frames fill in on the timeline; unsure frames are flagged
Tune the confidence threshold from the histogram
Save all propagated frames

flows.name: Trace and correct outlines by hand
flows.persona: Annotator working without the AI extra
flows.description: An annotator traces object outlines point by point, drags vertices to fix them, sets the class, and undoes mistakes.

steps.label: Switch to polygon mode with the toolbar button or its hotkey
Click points around the object; a click near the first point or Space closes it
The outline becomes a labeled object
Drag vertices to fix the outline
Rename a class in the class table
Undo a mistake

flows.name: Convert existing labels to the formats a training pipeline needs
flows.description: An ML engineer opens a folder labeled in one format, picks the export formats the pipeline needs, and re-saves each image.

steps.label: Open the labeled folder; the file table shows which formats exist
Choose the export formats; they are saved to settings.json when the app closes
Open an image; the most faithful existing file is loaded
Save; every chosen format is written beside the image
